narrator.rule: The narrator only says what the profile says. Every sentence can be traced to a section, a claim or the music/movement DNA.
narrator.identity: one narrator for the whole atlas: the same face and animation everywhere; a native-speaker voice of the same character per language (studio-grade); the viewer chooses the language

scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance has its roots in the Amazigh culture of the original inhabitants of the Canary Islands.
Following the Spanish conquest, it integrated European poetic forms.
By the 16th century, it was performed in European courts and is considered the probable inspiration for the 'Canary' dance popular in the 16th and 17th centuries.
on_screen: Map: Spain · Europe
Image 1 with attribution

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: The Tajaraste is a celebratory dance used to tell stories through song.
The romances performed alongside the dance preserve historical narratives of forbidden love and local miracles.
Today it is a living tradition.
on_screen: Footage — MISSING (use images)

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: It is a collective dance performed in pairs.
The movement is upbeat and syncopated.
While specific choreography changes based on the island of origin (Tenerife or La Gomera), it maintains a happy, energetic character throughout the performance.
on_screen: Hero video full screen, 30–45 s (2FeiCeuRHFY)

scenes.title: Listen
narration: The music is defined by a syncopated rhythm.
Key instruments include the drum (tambor), tambourine (pandero), and chácaras (large castanet-like instruments).
Listen for the tambourine, drum, chácaras.
A percussive-heavy sound dominated by the sharp clacking of chácaras and the steady beat of drums or tambourines, overlaid with narrative vocal storytelling.

Vocal style: Romances (narrative singing). Mood: upbeat, happy, syncopated, festive. It should sound like this: A percussive-heavy sound dominated by the sharp clacking of chácaras and the steady beat of drums or tambourines, overlaid with narrative vocal storytelling.
